issues: 柱群只有画面高度的三分之一，挤在下半屏，上方大片死黑，构图没有重心
"值梯度"只能靠肉眼比高矮去猜：画面里没有任何数字告诉观众每根柱拿到的值
代码字幕是 9.5px 设计坐标放大的灰色小字，几乎读不出，换句时也看不清换了什么
第二拍 from:'center' 的原点没有任何视觉标记，中心脉冲读作整排随机抖动
蓝→紫的霓虹色带和平底配色是最常见的模板味，柱子没有地面、空间与光
changes: look 换成 lime（石墨底 · 荧光黄绿），色相梯度改为 80°→30° 的热度色带（黄绿 → 琥珀 → 橙），落在带倒影的镜面地板与地平线光带上
构图放大：16 根柱占画宽 83%、最高 560px，左侧值刻度 + 底部索引刻度，代码字幕升格为 44px 语法着色主标题 + 拍号眉题
每根柱头一枚 32px 等宽数值标签：拍一随柱升起计数到 92…32，换拍时从中心向两端逐个滚换成脉冲幅度 +06…+42…+06——值梯度变成可读证据
第二拍原点可视化：中心脚下亮起原点三角与 FROM CENTER，基线上一道光从中心向两端跑，前沿与脉冲波前同一函数驱动
时间表重写为 165f：33f 时间错峰 + 26f expo-out 入场、13f hold、10f 字幕上卷交换、38f 中心脉冲、41f 静止；柱群裁在基线上方，行程读作从地板槽升起
全程 1.000→1.025 极缓推镜；脉冲只加高度与外发光，不把暖色柱洗白
issuesEn: The bars filled only a third of the frame height, crammed into the lower half under a large dead black area, with no visual centre of gravity
The value gradient could only be guessed by comparing heights; no number on screen told you what value each bar received
The code caption was tiny grey text scaled up from 9.5px design units, barely legible, so the line swap didn't say what had changed
The from:'center' origin of beat two had no visual marker, so the centre pulse read as random ripples across the row
The blue-to-purple neon ramp on a flat background was template-generic; the bars had no floor, space or light
changesEn: Lime look (graphite with fluorescent yellow-green); the hue gradient becomes an 80°→30° heat ramp (lime → amber → orange) standing on a reflective floor with a horizon glow

Scaled-up composition: 16 bars span 83% of the frame width and up to 560px tall, with a value axis and index ticks; the code caption becomes a 44px syntax-highlighted headline with a beat-number eyebrow

A 32px mono value tag on every bar: in beat one it counts up to 92…32 as the bar rises, and at the switch it rolls over from the centre outward to the pulse amplitudes +06…+42…+06, so the value gradient becomes readable evidence

Beat two's origin is visualised: an origin caret and FROM CENTER light up under the middle, and a light runs along the baseline from the centre outward, its front driven by the same function as the pulse wavefront

Timeline rewritten to 165f: 33f time stagger with 26f expo-out entrances, 13f hold, 10f caption roll, 38f centre pulse, 41f still; bars are clipped above the baseline so their travel reads as rising out of a floor slot
A very slow 1.000→1.025 push for the whole shot; the pulse adds height and outer glow only, without washing the warm bars out to white
